name: @pipeworx/mcp-nevada-code

tools.name: nv_revised_statute
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Nevada Revised Statutes — Nevada state law — by citation. "NRS 200.010" defines murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does NRS 484C.110 say" or to check a Nevada statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "200.010" (murder) or "484C.110" (DUI). Chapter is the part before the dot.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nevada-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nevada-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
